about_the_game:
Read the forgotten journals. Rally the outcast horde. Crack the rune‑box before the world forgets the goblins were ever here.

Puzzle out the field notes of a long‑lost goblin commander, plot a path across shifting battle maps, and watch your carefully loaded squads clash in turn‑based auto‑battles.

Each journal becomes your next roguelite campaign: three escalating parchment maps, dozens of ambushes and intrigues, and a last‑stand finale whose outcome rewrites the legend.

Will your translations redeem the scattered clans—or doom them to fade into myth forever?

FEATURES
  • Plan, Place, Watch Chaos Unfold – Slot abilities before each turn‑based auto battle, then adapt between rounds as enemy tactics mutate.
  • Nine Hand‑Authored “Runs” – Every journal shuffles 70+ combat encounters, 30+ narrative events, and fort hubs for hiring, healing, or shopping.
  • Four Tactical Archetypes – Commander, Shield, Pair, and Bulky each wield 6 skills that steer AI behaviour.
  • 30+ Run‑Changing items – Torch‑lit talismans, poisoned provisions, map‑wide tricks—mix them for brutal synergies or last‑second clutch saves.

name: Goblin Journal

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Graphics: Support for OpenGL 3.3
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: Goblin Journal is a roguelike turn-based RPG about the final days of the goblin race. Give orders, make difficult decisions, and keep up the morale of your squad to unlock a runic box that holds their legacy.
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Italian
